prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore with workspace-only 404 enforcement and position restoration, added localized Undo toast support on the Episodes page, and verified with backend tests, TypeScript checks, and live headless Chrome browser checks in both English and Korean.

+from sqlmodel import Session

+from app.models import Project, Workspace, WorkspaceMember

+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Test Webtoon"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title="Episode 1", order=1, summary="Opening scene"):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": order,
+            "story_summary": summary,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_cut(client, headers, episode_id, order, script, layout="wide", ratio="16:9", dialogues=None, characters=None, image_path=None):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": order,
+            "script": script,
+            "selected_layout": layout,
+            "aspect_ratio": ratio,
+            "dialogues": dialogues or [],
+            "appearing_characters": characters or [],
+            "image_path": image_path,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    cut = r.json()
+    if characters:
+        upd = client.put(
+            f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut['id']}",
+            headers=headers,
+            json={"appearing_characters": characters},
+        )
+        assert upd.status_code == 200, upd.text
+        cut = upd.json()
+    return cut
+
+
+def test_duplicate_episode_copies_metadata_and_cuts_in_order(client):

+from sqlmodel import Session

+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Restore Webtoon"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title="Episode", order=1, summary="Summary"):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": order,
+            "story_summary": summary,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_cut(client, headers, episode_id, order, script, image_path=None):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": order,
+            "script": script,
+            "selected_layout": "wide",
+            "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
+            "dialogues": [{"speaker": "Hero", "text": f"Line {order}"}],
+            "image_path": image_path,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+

+def test_restore_episode_returns_to_previous_position_with_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 1", order=1)
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 2", order=2, summary="Middle episode")
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 3", order=3)
+
+    c1 = _create_cut(client, h, ep2["id"], order=1, script="Cut 1", image_path="cuts/ep2/1.png")
+    c2 = _create_cut(client, h, ep2["id"], order=2, script="Cut 2", image_path="cuts/ep2/2.png")
+
+    # Delete Ep 2 -> Ep 3 shifts up to 2
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    listed_deleted = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in listed_deleted] == [ep1["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed_deleted] == [1, 2]
+
+    # Restore Ep 2 -> comes back at order 2, Ep 3 moves down to 3
+    res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    restored = res.json()
+    assert restored["id"] == ep2["id"]
+    assert restored["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert restored["story_summary"] == "Middle episode"
+    assert restored["first_cut_image"] and restored["first_cut_image"].endswith("cuts/ep2/1.png")
+
+    listed_restored = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in listed_restored] == [ep1["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed_restored] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+    # Cuts are preserved in order
+    cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep2['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [c["id"] for c in cuts] == [c1["id"], c2["id"]]
+    assert [c["cut_order"] for c in cuts] == [1, 2]
+    assert [c["script"] for c in cuts] == ["Cut 1", "Cut 2"]
+

+def test_restore_episode_shifts_later_episodes_and_clamps_end(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 1", order=1)
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 2", order=2)
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 3", order=3)
+
+    # Delete Ep 2 (order 2), duplicate Ep 1 (copy at 2, Ep 3 at 3), then restore Ep 2 -> goes at 2, others move down
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    ep1_copy = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+
+    res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in listed] == [ep1["id"], ep2["id"], ep1_copy["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed] == [1, 2, 3, 4]
+
+    # Delete Ep 3 (at order 4) and Ep 1 copy + Ep 2, leaving only Ep 1 -> restoring Ep 3 clamps cleanly to order 2
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep3['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1_copy['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+
+    res3 = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep3['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert res3.status_code == 200, res3.text
+    listed_final = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in listed_final] == [ep1["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed_final] == [1, 2]
+

+def test_restore_episode_workspace_authorization_and_404(client):
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+
+    owner_h = signup(client, email="restore-owner@example.com")
+    outsider_h = signup(client, email="restore-outsider@example.com")
+    member_h = signup(client, email="restore-member@example.com")
+
+    project = _create_project(client, owner_h)
+    ep = _create_episode(client, owner_h, project["id"], title="Protected Ep", order=1)
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}", headers=owner_h).status_code == 204
+
+    # Unauthenticated -> 401
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore").status_code == 401
+
+    # Non-member -> 404 (not 403)
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore", headers=outsider_h).status_code == 404
+
+    # Nonexistent UUID -> 404
+    assert client.post("/api/v1/episodes/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/restore", headers=owner_h).status_code == 404
+
+    # Workspace member CAN restore
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        proj = session.get(Project, project["id"])
+        teammate = session.query(User).filter(User.email == "restore-member@example.com").first()
+        session.add(WorkspaceMember(workspace_id=proj.workspace_id, user_id=teammate.id, role="member"))
+        session.commit()
+
+    res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore", headers=member_h)
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    assert res.json()["id"] == ep["id"]
+
+    # Non-member still gets 404 on active episode
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore", headers=outsider_h).status_code == 404
+
+    # Idempotent restore on active episode does not duplicate or break numbering
+    res_again = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore", headers=owner_h)
+    assert res_again.status_code == 200
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=owner_h).json()
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed] == [1]
